quote: getTables() is called without a schema
author: Santos Sabanari

quote: It reads structure only, meaning tables, columns, keys, and indexes, and never queries row data, so you don't need to point an external GUI client at the database or regenerate a static diagram every time you run a migration.
author: Yannick Lyn Fatt

quote: I saw a new Laravel package to view/export/review your database schema, with just one "composer require" and zero configuration.
author: Povilas Korop

quote: On larger SaaS codebases, understanding how tables relate to each other is something that usually requires either a paid GUI tool or a manually maintained diagram that drifts over time.
author: Mohamed Said

quote: Inheriting a messy codebase used to cost me days of figuring out how the data is structured and how the tables connect. Now it takes 10 minutes.
author: Haseeb Mirza

quote: [Bug] Table connection prefix (`prefix` / `DB_PREFIX`) causes empty columns, keys, and foreign   key relationships
author: Nguyễn Tiến Lộc

quote: بتقرأ الـ schema الحقيقي من قاعدة البيانات، مش ملفات الـ migrations، فبتكون دايمًا محدثة
translation: It reads the real schema from the database, not the migration files, so it is always up to date.
author: Amr Lotfy Saleh

quote: Sometimes the hardest part of working with a database isn't writing the query… It's understanding the database itself.
author: Bhavin Vaghadiya

quote: Instead of opening your DB client and jumping between tables, Laravel Truss gives you a live, interactive ER diagram directly inside your Laravel app.
author: Mohammad Ghanem

quote: [Bug] Uncaught cache-store failure crashes `php artisan migrate` and the `/truss` dashboard

quote: Sometimes, a visual diagram explains a database much faster than reading 20 migration files.
